title: A little less unfolding.
subtitle: Keep every customer’s choices, exact source boxes and handling steps together.
empty: Start a customer session to build a shortlist.
closeDescription: Retrieved garments must be sold or returned, and drafts completed or abandoned first.
shortlistNote: Selection only. Stock is not reserved or deducted.
none: No unplanned selections. Browse the showroom and add exact colour/size variants.
clearDescription: This removes only unplanned shortlist items. Existing retrievals and bills stay unchanged.
pickNote: Retrieved garments remain on-hand until a demo sale completes.
noPicks: Generate a pick list from your shortlist to see exact rack, shelf and box allocations.
returnWarning: {count} retrieved / return-pending lines still need to be sold or physically returned.
locked: In a draft bill. Abandon that draft to change handling.
